verdict.rationale: The published pages advertise online formation and an Annual Report Wizard, but none of them say whether these flows can be started without an account, or by entering a file number. The only documented Filing ID entry point belongs to entity search, which is a different flow from filing. The probe shows only that the public Business Center landing page loads without credentials; it does not show the filing flow itself starting keylessly.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
